articles.author: Selina Guevara, Shaquille Brewster, Minyvonne Burke
articles.title: Caleb Flynn, former ‘American Idol’ singer, found guilty of wife’s murder - NBC News
articles.description: Ashley Flynn was fatally shot in her Ohio home in February. Caleb Flynn had said a burglar broke in and killed her.
articles.content:
Former American Idol singer Caleb Flynn was found guilty Tuesday of murdering his wife in their Ohio home in February.
